indices.name: S&P 500
indices.note: ETF-based estimate from SPY fund holdings. State Street also publishes index top holdings separately. Official S&P 500 weights require a license. Dual-class shares, such as GOOGL and GOOG, are separate lines.

indices.name: Dow Jones Industrial Average
indices.note: ETF-based estimate from DIA fund holdings. The Dow is price-weighted. Official DJIA weights require a license.

indices.name: Russell 2000
indices.note: ETF-based estimate from IWM fund holdings. Official Russell weights require a paid FTSE Russell subscription.
